clearly_out.why: Two unrelated tree-sitter field accessors (gh #460, gh #532). One tests for a `keyword_argument` node, fetches its `value` field and returns it; the other tests for an `assignment` node, fetches its `left` field and records the identifiers under it. Node kind, field name and body all differ; what they share is the only shape a typed field read against a tree-sitter grammar can take. Extracting a helper would fold two behaviours together and save nothing. Reporting them is a false positive.
clearly_out.verified: diff of crates/deslop-core/src/cluster_filters/calls/args.rs:134-139 against crates/deslop-core/src/cluster_filters/calls/asserts.rs:164-168 at the pinned sha: of the five lines that overlap, three differ - the kind string, the field string and the statement inside; the two that agree are the closing braces. A copy of this pair is the `content-gate-unsaturated` fixture, which the scan excludes under **/tests/fixtures/**.
